title: Integrality of the multiplicity of a rectifiable weak limit (printed (7)–(10))
statement: Assume m + 2 ≤ P, SlicingTheorem and LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity. Let T_j, T ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with T_j integer multiplicity, ∂T_j = 0, sup_j M(T_j) < ∞, T_j ⇀ T, and suppose T is rectifiable (IsRectifiableCurrent: T = τ(M,θ,ξ) with real θ > 0). Then T is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 2 ≤ P → SlicingTheorem → LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity → ∀ (Tj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Tj j)) → (∀ j, (Tj j).boundary = 0) → (⨆ j, (Tj j).mass) < ∞ → WeaklyConvergesOn Tj T → IsRectifiableCurrent T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
